subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should heading-aware chunking become memory-core's default chunking behavior, an opt-in strategy/config, or stay deferred until the Memory MVP indexing design is settled?
rationale: The fix changes persistent memory index semantics and may add a config/default surface, while the issue also bundles broader entity extraction and graph-memory behavior that belongs to a separate product boundary decision.

options.title: Scope memory-core chunking first
options.body: Implement heading-aware chunking with explicit index identity and reindex tests, while leaving entity extraction to Memory MVP or plugin follow-up.

options.title: Make it opt-in only
options.body: Add a documented strategy/config and preserve token chunking as the upgrade default until live retrieval proof justifies changing defaults.

options.title: Defer to Memory MVP
options.body: Keep this issue open as design input and avoid a separate chunker change until the broader memory write/indexing model is finalized.

recommendation.title: Scope memory-core chunking first
recommendation.body: Implement heading-aware chunking with explicit index identity and reindex tests, while leaving entity extraction to Memory MVP or plugin follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans memory-core indexing, memory-wiki synthesis boundaries, and the broader Memory MVP ownership trail.
